{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Compute change in biomarker
trial_df['biomarker_change'] = trial_df['biomarker_final'] - trial_df['biomarker_baseline']

# Identify rows where baseline or final is sentinel (-999.0)
has_sentinel = (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0) | (trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0)

# Count how many such rows
num_with_sentinel = has_sentinel.sum()
print('Number of patients with -999.0 in baseline or final:', num_with_sentinel)
print('\n')

# Now compute mean change by arm, excluding sentinel cases
trial_df_clean = trial_df[~has_sentinel]
mean_change_by_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean()
print('Mean biomarker change by arm (excluding sentinel cases):')
print(mean_change_by_arm)"}
